opening.argument: The video provides a step-by-step walkthrough for reaching Facebook support chat, beginning with logging in to a Facebook account and entering the displayed support URL. It then shows the support process: completing fields for a name, phone number, registered email ID, and ad account ID, selecting “Start Chat,” and using “Get started” before entering a queue to chat with a Facebook representative. The title expressly describes a “Full Process” for contacting Facebook and Instagram support, while the separate marketer contact frame is not connected to these instructions. The material presents no investment, payment, or deceptive solicitation, supporting its educational and operational purpose.

citations.quote: How to Contact Facebook Chat Support | Instagram Chat Support | Facebook Customer Care? Full Process
